fusions.name: Gleaning Cut
fusions.desc: A curved cut that deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Wide Reap
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide arc, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and ignoring armour. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sheaves Stored
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 60% for 15 seconds. You restore 8 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Sheaf by Sheaf
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
